title: QuScope: An Open-Source Python Framework for Quantum-Circuit Simulation of Transmission Electron Microscopy
summary: Image formation in transmission electron microscopy (TEM) is governed by the coherent evolution of the electron wavefunction through the specimen and the objective lens. This physics maps naturally onto the gate model of quantum computation. We present QuScope, an open-source Python framework that expresses the complete TEM image-formation pipeline as quantum circuits. The $N\times N$ electron wavefunction is amplitude-encoded in $2\log_2 N$ qubits, and every optical element, including phase-grating transmission, Fresnel propagation between specimen slices, and the aberrated objective lens,…
